name: snd_init
note: loads 099.HES detect module, picks AdLib(type1) else Beeper(type0), sets DS:1602, loads 098/095.HES, psm_install

name: music_load_play
note: reads header via hes_read, LZW-unpacks song into para-aligned buffer DS:8ff8, driver slot 6(ptr,len); only called near (push cs) from music_on_enter

name: snd_shutdown
note: EXTRA row: not in functions.tsv (only atexit-referenced); calls psm_uninstall

name: music_on_enter
note: owner = DAT_7a16 (1-based room owner, compared with DS:8b88); song chosen only if AdLib (DS:1602==1); state DS:1604 song, DS:1606 last room

name: music_on_leave
note: stops/frees song unless the next room keeps the same music; DS:1608 last room

name: para_align
note: far ptr -> (seg+1):(off&0xfff0), returned in DX:AX; in port just return p (or align)
